name: NGC 3717 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3717, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3717-hubble
story: Seen almost in profile, NGC 3717 shows how a spiral's thin disk wraps around a central bulge, like a flying saucer seen from the side. It is tilted just enough for the view to cross the disk and reveal one side of the bulge.

claims.text: NGC 3717 is a spiral galaxy, seen almost in profile
Spirals' bulges give them a flying-saucer shape when seen edge-on
NGC 3717 is tilted slightly, letting the view show one side of the central bulge
